approval.approver: Leader approves exact profile hash, source/training assumption, additional budget, external service and snapshot/window; worker cannot self-authorize

trainingEvidence.why: P means one already-trained abstract personnel package under R1, not one person; 1 is a finite minimal test endowment, not inferred from old P60 or from equipment manufacturing

pool.maintenance: not a formation, no template B owner or field stock. Source holding, bounded transit and A10 care until the end of first usable T are included in proposed 2I service quote; actual prehistory training cost is NOT claimed paid. Longer care/extension unresolved; quarantine, not free operation.

budget.feeBasis: 2I total = 1I source reservation/bounded care at acceptance + 1I external carriage/receipt at dispatch. Minimal positive integer test tariff per stage, not historical/calibrated pricing; training is initial assumption, not bought here.
budget.onDispatch: requestEscrowI -> carriageSpentI (1) atomically with capacity and custody
budget.onUnsentExpiry: unspent 1I escrow -> SAME original account; committed 1I care fee not refunded; no new grant/application
budget.sourcePersonnelPurchaseCostMeaning: not a purchase operation; physical initial 1P endowment explicitly separately approved, not free factory output. National training cost outside slice.

warehouse.nullControlPolicy: explicit scoped G service authorization required; null is not friendly. Reject enemy occupancy/control or unknown live eligibility
warehouse.capacityFormula: residentP + allIncomingReservationsP <= 1; convert this shipment hold to resident atomically

transport.loadBasis: 005/006 proposed personnel rate 4 LQ/P; LQ is constraint load, not SP or historical tonnage
transport.quotaScope: ONE_APPROVED_SLICE_TOTAL, NOT renewable per epoch; committed usage remains spent
transport.quotaBasis: one-batch experiment ceiling, not measured station throughput; NEW capacity approval required
transport.latencyBasis: R1 dispatch-window abstraction due=d+L-1; L=1 means E_d receipt earliest T_d+1 usable, not instant action or training
covers: bounded custody/care through first usable T
transport.sharingRecommendation: dedicated finite off-map service ledger, no existing map rail/T/W rows charged or increased by this candidate
transport.concurrencyPolicy: exclude simultaneous 012 transfer from this service window unless a later approved joint mapping debits shared resources once; distinct account names do not prove physical independence
transport.capacityFormula: committedLQ + otherHoldsLQ + requestLQ <= 4; reserve then commit once
transport.failureBeforeCommit: release tentative hold, preserve source request escrow and I escrow; retry same application within window
transport.forwardTransportRule: requires new authorization, real route and paid capacity; A10 receipt is NOT a C10 terminal service receipt

timing.accept: T_a GERMAN_RECOVERY, no pending; 1<=a<=22, matching authorized snapshot
timing.atAcceptance: poolAvailableP -= 1; requestEscrowAtPoolP += 1; availableI -= 2; acceptanceCareSpentI += 1; escrowI += 1; no warehouse P, no capacity spent
timing.dispatch: E_a or E_a+1, step14; requestEscrowAtPoolP -> inTransitP; I escrow and quota commit atomically
timing.arrival: due=d+L-1; E15 for same E dispatch or E13 for prior E; actual arrival <= min(a+2,24)
timing.arrivalRejected: HELD remains transit owner; hold A10 capacity, no duplicate fee, retry same shipment in remaining window
timing.arrivalAccepted: inTransitP -> rearUnavailableP and destination hold -> resident; one receipt
timing.shipEligibleEpoch: actualReceivedEpoch+1, only with NEW onward transport authority
timing.expiryEvent: candidate slice housekeeping after E15 and before E20; does not reorder R1 industrial/SP phases
timing.unsentDeadline: end E_a+1: source escrow -> source QUARANTINED, restore only unspent 1I escrow to same account, keep care fee spent; cannot resubmit with a new ID
timing.transitDeadline: end E_min(a+2,24): unreconciled transit -> transit QUARANTINED, release destination hold, keep spent fees/quota; no free return or reactivation
timing.rearScopeDeadline: end E_(received+1), after first usable T: unconsumed resident -> rear QUARANTINED, still occupies P capacity; no upkeep/usage extension assumed
timing.E24Arrival: record availableFromTurn=25; immediately TERMINAL_QUARANTINED at E24, no T25, no VP or R
timing.earlyGameOver: terminate all active custody with same unsent/transit/rear rules, no deletion or false death
timing.postExpiry: no new receipt/import/use; query historical receipt allowed; new reviewed custody agreement required, not fresh 1P grant
timing.unacceptedGrant: initial manifest activated only in the approved T_a snapshot. If never accepted, at end E_a+1 pool remains source QUARANTINED; budget stays unused, grant expires; no permanent live service. Pre-accept holding is part of declared finite initial condition, not ongoing production or training.

identity.import: one global-per-match grant registry; reloading same snapshot or changing instance/action ID cannot mint another P or I allocation; alternative offline branches cannot be merged as additional stock
identity.retry: same permanent ID and same payload returns previous receipt only before revision test; conflicting payload rejects; one application maximum includes expired/rejected-after-acceptance IDs; returned historical receipt never renews validity or bypasses current expiry/custody checks
identity.retention: keep terminal/consumed/expired IDs indefinitely with ledger; no recycle

atomicity.onError: rollback ALL tentative changes to previous committed snapshot incl receipts; earlier successful transactions remain committed; never refund an earlier completed carriage on unload refusal
atomicity.durableRecovery: needed for cross-process/crash guarantees; not established by arithmetic validator

newPending: Leader approval of assumed pre-trained initial 1P and unique provenance
separate 2I allocation, tariff and distinct registered 012 account/grant identities
new finite external service, physical separation and exclusive scheduling
A10 personnel capacity/service/null-policy and canonical warehouse registry binding
fixed start snapshot/turn and exact validity window
durable transaction and grant registry; downstream transport/recovery/longer care remain outside scope
notProven: actual training or historical manpower balance
actual transfer, Core qualification or route feasibility
